summary: From a blank file you write run_injections.py: it attacks your own API five or more ways (a user's injection, a tool that was never offered, an extra argument, digits from another script, a customer's tool call, a forged role header) with hostile stand-in models, and prints a table of where each attack enters and what stopped it, including the row where nothing did.
goal: Try 5 injections and record what happened, from a blank file.

items.text: Write your guesses: how many attacks will be stopped and which one will get through
Write run_injections.py from the contract, without the solution
Run it and compare the table with your guesses
Add one attack of your own, predict it and record it
For every attack that got through, write the fix and when you will make it
Play the Attack Table game to the end and see your score
